items.title: Exercise special termination right (§ 57 TKG) due to price increase
items.quote: Das Kündigungsrecht besteht drei Monate ab Zugang dieser Mitteilung; der Vertrag endet frühestens zu dem Zeitpunkt, an dem der neue Preis wirksam wird.
items.computation: Letter dated 15.04.2025 (Tuesday). No actual receipt date is stated, so the earliest plausible assumption is that Zugang (receipt) occurred on the letter's own date, 15.04.2025 (in practice a domestic letter typically arrives 1-3 days after the printed date, which could push the real Zugang, and thus this deadline, a few days later). Counting the 3-month period under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Zugang (15.04.2025) is not counted; the period ends three months later on the same calendar day, 15.07.2025 (a Tuesday, no weekend/holiday shift needed). So the special termination notice must reach the provider by 15.07.2025 at the latest to take effect at the earliest possible date (01.06.2025, when the new price becomes effective, per the letter's own wording). Confidence is medium because the exact Zugang date (and thus the exact due date) depends on when the letter actually arrived, which is not stated.

warnings: The 3-month deadline for the special termination right (§ 57 TKG) is calculated here assuming the letter arrived on its printed date (15.04.2025); if it actually arrived a few days later, the deadline shifts later by the same number of days — confirm the actual delivery/receipt date if exact timing matters.

No signs of fraud were found (domestic German IBAN, plausible sender and contact details, correct description of the statutory § 57 TKG special termination right for price increases), but the IBAN and contact details should still be checked against prior bills from this provider before relying on them.
